resources.string: Enable nl2sh Android Bridge in Accessibility settings. It accepts device-local shell/root calls; nl2sh still requires its own confirmation before any action.

Optionally select nl2sh Keyboard as the on-screen keyboard. Unicode input then works in every app, including fields that report no editable state. Its only key switches back to your previous keyboard.
Current on-screen keyboard: your usual keyboard
Switch the on-screen keyboard with the system keyboard switch gesture or the navigation bar button.
